source_text.body:
Apply to 50 jobs in under 30 minutes
Claude computer use submitted 50 job applications in under 30 minutes, shown in a video demo.
Done with
CU
Claude computer use
What they did
User enabled Claude computer use on their machine. The agent then handled job search and submission steps across sites to apply to positions.
How it went
It submitted 50 applications in under 30 minutes.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
Help me apply to [number, e.g. 10] [job title] jobs in [location or remote] using my resume at [file path] and the job board [site name]. For each posting, fill in the application using my resume and these details: [phone, work authorization, salary expectations]. Keep a list of each company, role, and link as you go, and stop when you've completed [number] applications. Before you submit any application, pause and show me what you're about to send so I can approve it.
Original source: https://x.com/arsh_goyal/status/2036492368149619042
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

translation.body:
在不到 30 分钟内申请 50 份工作
Claude computer use 在不到 30 分钟内提交了 50 份求职申请，视频演示展示了这一过程。
实际使用
Claude computer use
他们做了什么
用户在自己的机器上启用了 Claude computer use。随后，agent 在多个网站上处理职位搜索和提交步骤，以申请职位。
结果如何
它在不到 30 分钟内提交了 50 份申请。
自己试试
推荐工具
Claude computer use
复制提示词
请使用位于[文件路径]的我的简历，以及招聘网站[网站名称]，帮我申请[地点或远程]的[数量，例如 10]份[职位名称]工作。对于每条招聘信息，请使用我的简历和以下资料填写申请：[电话号码、工作许可、薪资期望]。在进行过程中，持续记录每家公司的名称、职位和链接，并在完成[数量]份申请后停止。提交任何一份申请之前，都请暂停并向我展示你即将发送的内容，以便我批准。
原始来源：https://x.com/arsh_goyal/status/2036492368149619042
translation.scope: 既有案例全文逐段翻译：标题/简介/实际工具/方法/结果/推荐模板全部占位符、公司职位链接清单、数量停止条件、每份提交前暂停展示并审批及原链接均保留。仅省略装饰头像CU。原文没有Worth knowing段，未补写。50份及不到30分钟保持来源声称，不插入文档、分析或实测结论；不是未读X原帖或视频全文翻译。
